info.title: Sync Backend — Actual API Contract
info.description: Source-based contract; registered APIs may be disabled by readiness/config guards. Documentation is read-only. No production activation implied.

post.description: No bearer required. Registered route != enabled engine. cmd/server defaults to legacy. Explicit gemini_direct enables this separate route after live-mode, configuration and dependency initialization checks; absent dependencies return503. Final<=5; language is model classification. Album lookup is optional enrichment. UI image: album_artwork_url → youtube_thumbnail_url → local placeholder. Checkpoint is process-local one-hour capability, not user authorization.

post.summary: Create playlist from checkpoint or legacy video IDs
post.description: Bearer OR sync_session cookie required. recommendation_id field selects strict checkpoint variant: private only, stored verified order, title required, cannot send tracks or alter order. Checkpoint lost on restart; empty checkpoint409. Same session+checkpoint dedup/retry state is process-local; changed payload409; ambiguous write502, no blind retry. Normal server checkpoint handler can503 under unchanged Direct guard. Legacy variant is existing raw tracks1..20, supports private(default)/unlisted/public; not equivalent to verified checkpoint contract. Explicit cross-site/Origin mismatch is rejected even with bearer.

201.description: Created playlist or partial item failure. Already-written playlist/items never rolled back. Do not blindly retry ambiguous writes.

post.description: Existing legacy ImageAnalysis/preference discovery. JSON cap64KiB. preferences optional(defaults languages ko/en, count configured10, vocal_mode mixed). Actual behavior depends on configured legacy data/query mode; separate from Direct MVP.

get.description: Returns configured values only;503 when mobile settings missing. No fake Android package/signing data supplied by docs.

Browser/app-link transport page with one-time code query from mobile callback. HTML fallback; no Google token returned. Android must extract handoff and call exchange. Device App Link verification is deployment-dependent.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Mobile handoff carried by redirect, not consumed by this HTML handler.

channel_id.description: null when no YouTube channel resource.

channel_title.description: null when no YouTube channel resource.

satisfied.description: actual_korean_tracks>=2 computed from final returned tracks; classification is model metadata, not independently verified lyrics.

partial.description: true if returned count <5 OR actual model-classified Korean count <2. Shortage does not force empty tracks.

recommendation_id.description: Opaque checkpoint capability. In-memory, one-hour TTL; lost on restart. Do not log/share; playlist consumes stored verified order.

tracks.description: Verified, eligible tracks; may be empty. Never padded.

album_artwork_url.description: Actual iTunes metadata or null. Lookup failure does not remove the track.

album_title.description: Actual iTunes metadata or null. Lookup failure does not remove the track.

korean_eligible.description: true for model-classified ko/ko_en only. Artist nationality does not determine this.

lyric_language.description: Model-classified lyrics, not verified lyric metadata. unknown excluded from final selection.

thumbnail_url.description: Backward-compatible YouTube thumbnail alias; preserved alongside youtube_thumbnail_url.

session_token.description: Sensitive opaque Sync bearer session, NOT Google OAuth access/refresh token. No token example included; store securely.

tracks.description: Legacy raw-video variant; dedup preserves first appearance. Not the checkpoint contract.

title.description: Generated short English title; client can pass it as playlist request title.

description.description: Short Korean observable-scene noun phrase, e.g. 비 내리는 날 카페 창가 작업 공간; no unsupported location/emotion guesses.

code.description: Single-use mobile handoff code, not Google authorization code.
